correctness.rationale: The domain is the ordinary acyclic incidence-matching complex of K2n with natural C2×Sn action for every integer n≥2. The 2012 directed-forest theorem supplies concentrated degree-n rational homology with rank n²−1. The simplicial signed Lefschetz identity turns the character into a weighted sum over invariant whole orbits; every selected incidence-pair orbit has weight −1. Separate exact cycle-by-cycle counts for no left swap (c cycles, f fixed points) and swap (r even cycles, f fixed points, t two-cycles) give Z=(−1)^{c−1}(f²−1) and Z=(−1)^r(1−f+2t). The character follows with normalization (−1)^{n+1}, including n=2. Finally, the characters of the augmentation, oriented-pair exterior square and unordered-pair modules match exactly, and semisimplicity over Q proves the decomposition. The standalone finite verifier exhaustively matches all 56 class cases for n=2..6 and exact mod-two homology for n=2..5; the infinite conclusion is from the proof, not the experiments.

value.rationale: The natural complete-bipartite family has a known homotopy type but no previously identified natural homology representation. The result gives the complete rational character on all elements of the nontrivial C2×Sn graph symmetry subgroup, distinguishing 1- and 2-cycle sensitivity, parity twists, and explicit natural tensor-permutation components. The 2012 sphere count and 2019 group-automorphism classification do not determine these traces. This is an action-sensitive invariant for all n≥2, not a re-labeled numerical Betti count or arbitrary finite slice; no downstream result or full integral classification is claimed.
